text: To steenbarger on U: I ratify one trigger, close_above:pivot_high (D), with C16 written in: the close must come on volume at least 1.4x normal, no buy past +5% of the pivot (C17). in_zone:ma_20 (elder-lens, raschke) is not a CAN SLIM buy point; `subcomponents.energy.en_pos50` 91.5 near the highs is where C7 buys. wrong_if: a daily close back under the pivot on heavy volume, or a 7-8% loss from cost (C20). Regime: valid only into a confirmed uptrend (C1), void under distribution (C2); gate DELEGATED. What clears me: breakout volume shown; `subcomponents.flow.volume_score` 2.0 is not it.
